title: The brand's own pages give found findings with exact sources; what they do not say is left unsettled

pages.text:
Lumen Shield Coatings
Home | Services | About | Contact
Ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes in Pune.
Your paint, protected for years. Book a coating at our Baner studio and drive out the same evening.
Packages from ₹14,999. Free pick-up and drop within Pune city limits.

Services
Ceramic Pro 9H - 3-year and 5-year packages
Graphene Max - 7-year package
Paint protection film (PPF) - bonnet, bumpers or full body
Interior detailing and leather care
All packages include a two-stage paint correction before coating.

About us
Lumen Shield was started in 2019 by two automotive engineers who were tired of swirl marks. We have coated more than 3,000 cars and bikes across Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad. Every car is handled by one trained detailer from start to finish.

Contact
Studio: Shop 4, Baner Road, Pune 411045
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98765 43210
Email: hello@lumenshield.example
Open Tuesday to Sunday, 9am to 7pm.
